_comment: Thành Tựu (app/systems/achievements.py, docs/THANH_TUU.md). Every achievement reads one counter (achievements.COUNTERS), optionally filtered by one 'where' field; its tiers are reached at rising 'at' values ('cult' takes a cultivation tier such as 'truc_co:2'). A tier's reward (spirit_stones, immortal_jade, items, title) is claimed with Nhận, except the title, given on unlock; 'req' is the cultivation tier needed to claim it (default: the highest unlock tier of its items in loot_tiers.json, the tier itself for 'cult'). Points (Đạo Tâm) count on unlock and open the milestones. A hidden achievement shows '???' and its hint_vi until earned, then its reveal_vi. Checked by achievements.validate() (tools/check_all.py).
